purpose: Prospectively freeze the first full-hierarchy learned comparison before reading development outcomes.

data.training_materialization: Prepare fixed-length gap arrays in RAM once per invocation; do not rewrite identities or persist dense examples.
data.development_contact: Always unknown. Never derive contact inputs or contact loss from hidden development target motion.
data.confirmation: Sealed and absent from this trainer.

optimization.epoch_order: Every frozen window once per epoch, shuffled deterministically within each gap from seed, epoch and gap.
optimization.selection: Lowest aggregate unknown-contact development loss after at least six epochs; final cohort gates are evaluated separately from training.

contact_ablation.unknown_contact: Zero all contact input/provenance fields and contact-loss weights for training.
contact_ablation.weak_contact: Use train-only heuristic foot contacts with confidence weighting; drop all contact inputs independently for 50 percent of training examples.
contact_ablation.promotion: Unknown mode may qualify independently. Weak mode is preferred only if both weak seeds pass all final gates and improve contact without material non-contact regression.

quality_evaluation.confirmation_after_development: Requires a separately frozen export and confirmation protocol only after one mode passes both seeds.

hard_stops: Do not change architecture, loss weights, seeds, masks, windows or thresholds after observing development outcomes.
Do not train another nearby TCN, Transformer, selector or loss-weight variant if this family fails.
Do not call a fitted checkpoint production-ready before detailed cohorts, ONNX parity, Bforartists latency, rig lifecycle and animator comparison pass.
